propositions: A new commit_and_push_tickets_branch entrypoint must acquire a write lock, optionally stage and commit dirty tracker changes with supplied or ambient git identity, then delegate to push_tickets_branch for delivery.

Rebase or merge-recovery in progress must block the commit phase: strict mode raises PushDeliveryError with merge-recovery-blocked reason; default mode warns and returns without staging, committing, or pushing.
Supplied author name and email must be applied per-commit via git -c flags without mutating global or repository config; ambient identity is used when omitted.

Lock, stage, or commit failures must raise PushDeliveryError with named reasons in strict mode and log warnings plus return without invoking push in default mode, preserving uncommitted content for retry.

Clean but locally-ahead trackers must push without creating empty commits; persistent rejection under strict mode preserves the local commit and raises PushDeliveryError rather than reporting success.
The new commit-and-push CLI action must route all arguments while preserving the existing push-only push action and using the same dependency-defined PushDeliveryError translation boundary.
